text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Dantsu! Keep up with me! DAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Pokke-chan! I won't lose! Yaaaaaaah!

Looking ahead to the Kikuka Sho, the two 
gradually increase their long-distance 
training, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong, down already? Could it be 
summer fatigue?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, physically I'm doing great! But... I'm 
still not really used to long distances.

Dantsu Flame casts a glance over here. As 
expected, the Kikuka Sho demands something 
different from anything before, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Dantsu, this is no time to be 
slumping!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right. I want to beat 
Pokke-chan and stand in the center too!

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Dantsu
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhhh! Yaaaaahhhh!

The two poured their all into it. Into 
their training, and... into their downtime 
fun as well.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, spooky spooky~. It's time for 
summer ghost stories~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAAT THE HEEEELL?! A ghost story?! Stop 
it, stop it, cut it ooout!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I just can't deal with opponents my 
fists can't hurt. Brrrrrr...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Episode 1: "The Strange Horse".

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That horse... Its face is white, but 
its name means black...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaaaa!
choice_data_list: Huh, so you have weaknesses too...
Huh, so you have weaknesses too...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, wipe that smirk off your face! 
Like hell I can stand here listening to 
this!

Even as Jungle Pocket spoke, she was 
trembling like a leaf.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, if listening isn't 
working, how about Pokke-chan does the 
talking this time?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Tell one? Me? A ghost story?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yeah, if you know any scary stories.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Like hell I'd know! Ah, but wait...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's not exactly a scary story, but I do 
know an eerie one.
choice_data_list:
A creepy story? Pokke, what do you 
mean...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'll never forget it. It was when I—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I overheard Fuji-san and 
Tachyon talking.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Did you understand? Tachyon, and...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I truly hope you will accept my advice on 
your running.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Fuji-san and Tachyon were the 
only ones talking. But...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I definitely felt like someone else was 
there. However, that person—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
My eyes couldn't see it. Was it just my 
imagination, or...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Was there... a ghost, or something?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
D-D-Don't talk nonsense! As if something 
like that exists!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! Trainer's not here, right? Tell 
me they're not!

It was an intriguing conversation. Was 
Fuji Kiseki giving advice to someone else 
besides Agnes Tachyon?

Even if that's a possibility, ghosts can't 
possibly exist in this world, surely...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "It's here! A ghoooost!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Y-You gotta be kidding me, man..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Let's go check it out, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hey! ...Tch.

Ghost or not, if there's trouble brewing, 
I can't just ignore it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You're Air Messiah-chan... right? You seem 
a bit... Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... it's like she's possessed 
by something; even the way she speaks and 
her personality have changed.

Air Messiah. A steady, dedicated worker 
running to vindicate her mother, a famous 
Umamusume, yet...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yo, yo, yo, check it out! My name is Slim 
Air.

Something is clearly off with her. She's 
speaking to me in English like a rapper.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, are you serious...? Can't say 
for sure if it's ghosts, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Stay back, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan? What are you...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I can't just leave someone who's 
completely passed out alone. ――I'll wake 
'em up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Time's up, blaow!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't really get it, but is it telling 
me to "get lost"?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who needs to get lost. I 
gotta find a way to kick you out, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should I do? How do I 
exorcise the ghost of a rapper?

I don't know the first thing about 
exorcisms, but we've gotta deal damage 
somehow and knock it out. To beat down 
this rapper ghost...
choice_data_list: Slug it out to the bitter end

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"A rap battle~!? Can I even do something 
like that?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—Bring it on, chiki-chiki! Carve it up, 
rhyme!”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the best, you're the rival. But you 
can't do nothin', you know it, yo!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, you're really challenging me 
to a rap battle!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, then I'll just learn by doing. Here 
I go!"

Jungle Pocket boldly challenged her 
opponent to a freestyle rap battle.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
This place is a jungle! A crazy jungle! My 
pocket's a jungle, too! Goo...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hippopotamuses, Poo! Giraffes, Nyuu! When 
the gorilla beats the drums, DokoDoko, 
Zoo!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Whoa, nice, nice, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: O-O-Oooh...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mboaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ――Did they do it!?

Thanks to the passionate rhymes laid down 
by Jungle Pocket, the miasma drained away 
from Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...!? Oh my, I am...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A brawl, huh? Guess we really do have no 
choice but to kick 'em out by force.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hit 'em with a big one! Alright, 
get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Urgh.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Pokke-chan?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's to help them... How could I 
ever hurt someone like that?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Dope. THEN, ALLOW ME TO—
(*Thud!*)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!
(WHAM! SMACK!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gaha, guh...!

"She isn't physically hitting her. Yet is 
Jungle Pocket... feeling phantom pain or 
something?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Do as much as you want, damn it! But once 
you're satisfied, get out of her body!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*... You done already? Is 
that... all you got...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"You... take a hit well... You're no toy 
soldier."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mboaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: H-Huh, something's off...

As a result of Jungle Pocket putting her 
body on the line, the miasma drained away 
from Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...!? Oh my, I am...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha... looks like you've finally come to 
your senses. Good grief, getting hijacked 
by something so pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So, Air Messiah. What happened? Why did 
you lose consciousness?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! Um... I was listening to 
music on my phone and accidentally played 
something I don't usually listen to...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As I listened, my consciousness gradually 
drifted away...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Could it be that listening to upbeat 
music just got you super hyped up?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe so. Well, anyway, glad you're 
safe."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there's no way ghosts 
actually exist. Right, Trainer?

And so, the midsummer ghost commotion was 
resolved. However...

What Jungle Pocket said about Fuji Kiseki 
weighed on my mind. Could there really not 
have been any ghosts?
